verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs confirm that calls can be recorded and come back transcribed and summarized. Call history and transcripts can be retrieved later with filters through its MCP integration. Nothing in the evidence covers jurisdiction-specific consent handling such as announcements or one- versus two-party consent settings, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: consent and disclosure handling per jurisdiction, explicit retrieval or search of the recording audio itself (not just transcripts), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number. Use filters to focus on what’s relevant.
